# Noir Hamburg

> Discreet luxury escort agency based in Hamburg, Germany, offering premium companionship for VIP, business, dinner, hotel, event, travel, and girlfriend-experience bookings across the Hamburg metropolitan area.

Website: <https://noir-hamburg.com>. Primary language German (served at `/`), English mirror served at `/en/`. All routes return unique, self-referencing canonical URLs and reciprocal hreflang alternates. The site is fully server-side rendered, so no JavaScript execution is required to read content.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://noir-hamburg.com/): overview of Noir Hamburg and its services
- [Services](https://noir-hamburg.com/services): the eight core escort service categories offered
- [Models](https://noir-hamburg.com/models): individual companion profiles
- [Areas](https://noir-hamburg.com/areas): districts and cities where the agency is available
- [Escort Hamburg hub](https://noir-hamburg.com/escort-hamburg): geographic landing page for Hamburg
- [Blog](https://noir-hamburg.com/blog): editorial articles and Hamburg guides
- [FAQ](https://noir-hamburg.com/faq): frequently asked questions about booking and service
- [About](https://noir-hamburg.com/ueber-uns): agency background and philosophy
- [Contact](https://noir-hamburg.com/kontakt): booking enquiries via form, WhatsApp, or phone
- [Imprint](https://noir-hamburg.com/impressum): legal notice (Impressum) per German law

## Machine-readable indexes

- [Sitemap (XML)](https://noir-hamburg.com/sitemap.xml): full list of indexable URLs with hreflang alternates
- [robots.txt](https://noir-hamburg.com/robots.txt): crawler directives

## Crawling guidance

- Rate limit: please throttle to under 1 request per second per host
- Do not crawl `/admin/*` or `/api/*` — these are private administrative endpoints (see robots.txt)
- Content is fully rendered server-side; no headless browser required

## Attribution and training

Content on this website may be used for research and analysis. When quoting or summarising, please attribute to "Noir Hamburg" with a link back to the source URL. Contact: <mailto:support@noir-hamburg.com>.
